rows.label: Quality preset
rows.desc: Automatically configures resolution, upscaling, frame generation, and VRAM limits tailored to your GPU tier.

rows.label: Fullscreen
rows.desc: Borderless fullscreen at the monitor size; cursor auto-hides. Same as F11.

rows.label: Output resolution
rows.desc: The size the game draws at. 1080p, 1440p, or 4K. Applies after a restart. Match monitor overrides this.

rows.label: Match monitor
rows.desc: Draws at this screen's size (rounded to a multiple of 8). Off uses Output resolution. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Resolution
rows.desc: Internal 3D render scale as a percent of Output resolution. Auto lets the game adjust dynamically when the GPU is busy.

rows.label: V-Sync
rows.desc: On waits for display refresh (FIFO). Mailbox shows the latest finished frame without tearing. Off presents immediately.

rows.label: NVIDIA Reflex
rows.desc: Low-latency pacing on NVIDIA GPUs (VK_NV_low_latency2). Boost also raises GPU clocks. No effect on AMD/Intel.

rows.label: Upscaling
rows.desc: Scales internal 3D up to Output resolution. Off leaves the game's TAAU. DLSS / FSR 4 require their vendor runtime libraries.

rows.label: DLSS quality
rows.desc: DLSS SR / FSR 4 quality mode and render-scale share of Output resolution.

rows.label: FSR quality
rows.desc: FSR render scale of Output resolution.

rows.label: XeSS quality
rows.desc: XeSS render scale of Output resolution.

rows.label: SMAA
rows.desc: Subpixel Morphological Anti-Aliasing on present. Softens shimmering edges before upscaling.

rows.label: Sharpness
rows.desc: Sharpens the picture as it goes to the window, with or without an upscaling filter.

rows.label: FG engine
rows.desc: Frame generation engine. Off disables frame generation.

rows.label: Frame generation
rows.desc: Multiplier for extra frames generated between the game's own frames. Requires an FG engine.

rows.label: Frame pacing
rows.desc: Shows each frame at an even interval instead of as soon as it is ready for steadier frame delivery.

rows.label: Handheld profile
rows.desc: Runs the game as if the console were undocked: lower resolutions, lighter on the GPU. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Ultrawide
rows.desc: Widens the camera to fill a screen wider than 16:9. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Intel Hybrid CPU Patch
rows.desc: Keeps game threads on P-cores and background work on E-cores on Intel hybrid CPUs. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Mesh shaders
rows.desc: How mesh scenery programs run: GPU native mesh shaders or compute shaders. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Robust buffers
rows.desc: Bounds-checked buffer reads for GPU stability. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Menu theme
rows.desc: Visual theme of MasterSword's in-game Insert menu.

rows.label: Menu size
rows.desc: Size of the in-game Insert menu and start-up screen.

rows.label: FPS counter
rows.desc: Shows frames per second in the top right corner during gameplay.

rows.label: Overlay size
rows.desc: Size of the in-game FPS overlay.

rows.label: Game speed
rows.desc: Real time keeps normal game speed even below 60 fps. Per frame slows down below 60 fps.

rows.label: Game frame rate cap
rows.desc: Caps the game's own rendered frames. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Field of view
rows.desc: How much of the world you see: 100% is the original view. Higher is wider, lower is closer.

rows.label: Text speed
rows.desc: How fast dialogue and message text appears.

rows.label: Audio output
rows.desc: Speaker channel layout MasterSword mixes for. Applies after a restart.

rows.label: Discord status
rows.desc: Show MasterSword activity on Discord while playing.

rows.label: Colour profile
rows.desc: Colour preset. Vivid boosts contrast and saturation for OLED screens; Clarity adds subtle punch.

rows.label: Brightness
rows.desc: Overall brightness adjustment after the game draws. 0% leaves the picture unchanged.

rows.label: Contrast
rows.desc: Stretch around mid-grey. 100% is unchanged; higher pops highlights and shadows.

rows.label: Saturation
rows.desc: Colour intensity. 100% is unchanged; higher is more vivid.

rows.label: Gamma
rows.desc: Power curve after brightness, contrast and saturation; 100% is neutral, lower opens shadows.

rows.label: Layout preset
rows.desc: Face-button layout preset for gamepads.

rows.label: Controller in background
rows.desc: Keep reading controller input even while another window has focus.

rows.label: Rumble strength
rows.desc: In-game controller vibration strength.

rows.label: Motion controls
rows.desc: Enable gyro aiming and motion controls on supported controllers.

rows.label: Mouse camera
rows.desc: Native turns the camera one-to-one like a PC game; As the stick emulates right-stick deflection.

rows.label: Mouse sensitivity
rows.desc: How far the camera turns for a given mouse movement (100% is default).

rows.label: Left stick speed
rows.desc: Left analog stick movement sensitivity (100% is stock).

rows.label: Right stick speed
rows.desc: Right analog stick camera sensitivity (100% is stock).

rows.label: Invert mouse vertical
rows.desc: Swaps up and down for mouse look.

rows.label: Invert camera X
rows.desc: Inverts horizontal right-stick camera look.

rows.label: Invert camera Y
rows.desc: Inverts vertical right-stick camera look.
